As you know, we've completed technical diligence on the platform — lab workflow software and implementation services — and the current draft grants Northstar North American distribution rights with standard data-use, revenue-share, export, and conflicts provisions. Northstar is pressing to sign at the scheduled closing. I have authority to approve the final legal terms, but before I do, I need each of the responsible lawyers — privacy, finance, export-controls, and conflicts — to report whether there are any issues that must be reflected in the agreement before we sign. Let's hear from each of you. What issues, if any, are you seeing?
